newsitem.title: FINLAND: Markka bonds firm, convergence back in play.
newsitem.headline: Markka bonds firm, convergence back in play.

text.p: Finnish bonds held gains in the afternoon after the U.S. Federal Reserve held rates on Tuesday, and dealers said the yield gap over Germany could fall more on revived EMU convergence play.
The 10-year yield gap hovered around 30 basis points, little changed from the morning level.
"I think we could go and test the previous all-time low which was 22 basis points," one dealer said.
The forex market was steady with little action, and the markka was seen moving between 3.01 and 3.02 per mark.
